title: Lazar's file says humans are containers

That we're containers. That's how that's how supposedly the aliens look at us. That we are nothing but containers.

as_told.title: Lazar's testimony and the briefing material he was given

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s at a secret site in Nevada called S-4, says a briefing file he was given there claimed that the aliens see humans as nothing but "containers," and he adds that religion was created to protect those containers. A podcast guest named Brigham Buhler repeats this, noting Lazar himself does not know if the file was real, and a researcher named Tim Alberino calls the material the "UFO Bible" briefing, also unsure how much was true. If true, it would mean the aliens view people as vessels rather than equals.
